neighbours.label: first sub-word piece of a surname split by the tokenizer, right after a given name (Neil ' Ring'el, Peter ' Mart'yn)
fire: Yesterday our team met with Laura Ringwald to discuss the budget.
The quote came from Daniel Martell, a reporter at the local paper.
For press inquiries, please contact Steven Kartch at the main office.
In the meeting, Helen Ringer explained the new hiring plan.
The essay was reviewed by Thomas Martyn for the spring issue.
According to Paul Martineau, the results were encouraging.
Last week I spoke on the phone with Brian Ringel about the contract.
The panel included Sarah Kartman, a policy analyst from Ohio.

For press inquiries, please contact Steven Walker at the main office.
In the meeting, Helen Parker explained the new hiring plan.

notes: card: ' Mart' x8, ' Ring' x6 in 'First Lastname' citations/contacts. Fire items put Ring/Mart/Kart-initial surnames after a first name; quiet items use surnames that are single tokens or start differently.
